description: Turn a document into an .xlsx workbook without a schema (one sheet per table). Takes a local file, URL or document_id, waits for the workbook and can save it locally. Credits: upload, plus 2/page for the conversion. Resume with the call in 'next'.

instructions.description: What the spreadsheet should contain, e.g. which tables or columns to keep.

save_to.description: Optional local path for the .xlsx file.

schema_id.description: A schemaId from an earlier conversion, to lay out similar files the same way.

upload_job_id.description: The upload job of document_id, when resuming.

name: convert_to_excel
title: Convert a document to Excel
